2608.05545.title: Vibe Compiler: A Research-Logic Synthesis Tool That Runs without Prompt Engineering -Toward Enhancing Metacognition for Sustaining Agency in the Age of Generative AI-
2608.05545.paper_summary: Generative AI used as a capable servant has greatly accelerated intellectual work, but it also risks eroding human epistemic agency by encouraging uncritical acceptance of AI-generated reasoning. This creates a need for mechanisms that preserve human agency by augmenting metacognition during AI-assisted intellectual work. To address this, we propose the Synthesis-Analysis Reciprocity Model, which views intellectual construction as a reciprocal interaction between Synthesis, which combines components into an artifact, and Analysis, which critically evaluates them against objective indicators and constrains subsequent synthesis. Grounded in this model, we present the Vibe Compiler, a research-logic compiler that helps researchers transform vague ideas (Vibes) into coherent research logic. The system compiles these ideas using a research paper ontology of sixteen academic parameters. Compilation failures indicate missing logical components; rather than filling them autonomously, the system prompts researchers with reflective questions that encourage them to develop the missing reasoning. The framework characterizes structural gaps along two dimensions: cognitive function (Synthesis vs. Analysis) and executing agent (human vs. AI), yielding four origin types that identify where breakdowns arise. Our design emphasizes AI probing its own synthesized output to stimulate human metacognition, encouraging researchers to remain managers who critically direct and validate AI-generated reasoning rather than passive recipients. Experience with a prototype built on NotebookLM and Gemini suggests that effective AI-assisted reasoning depends less on sophisticated prompting than on the knowledge structure provided to the AI. This paper was developed using the proposed Vibe Compiler.
2608.05545.paper_summary_zh: 生成式人工智慧作為一個有能力的助手，極大地加速了智力工作，但它也有可能通過鼓勵不加批判地接受人工智慧生成的推理來侵蝕人類的認知主體性。這創造了需要機制來保護人類主體性，通過在人工智慧輔助的智力工作中增強元認知。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了綜合-分析互惠模型，該模型將智力建構視為綜合（將組件結合成一個工件）和分析（根據客觀指標對其進行批判性評估並限制後續綜合）之間的互動。基於這一模型，我們介紹了Vibe Compiler，一種研究邏輯編譯器，幫助研究人員將模糊的想法（Vibes）轉化為連貫的研究邏輯。該系統使用包含十六個學術參數的研究論文本體來編譯這些想法。編譯失敗表明缺少邏輯組件；系統不會自動填補這些缺失，而是通過反思性問題提示研究人員，鼓勵他們發展缺失的推理。該框架沿著兩個維度特徵化結構性差距：認知功能（綜合與分析）和執行代理（人類與人工智慧），產生四種類型的起源，以識別故障發生的地方。我們的設計強調人工智慧探查其自身的綜合輸出，以刺激人類的元認知，鼓勵研究人員保持管理者的角色，批判性地引導和驗證人工智慧生成的推理，而不是被動的接受者。基於NotebookLM和Gemini構建的原型經驗表明，有效的人工智慧輔助推理不太依賴於複雜的提示，而更依賴於提供給人工智慧的知識結構。本文是使用所提出的Vibe Compiler開發的。
